title: Units uncovered under a Stack are summoning sick
notes: R1829000: a card a Stack pile uncovers, as the cards above it leave (destroyed, bounced, stolen, captured, tributed or gone), is summoning sick that turn as a card that entered the field on that turn is, its exertion kept; an Equip host a fusion keeps keeps its turn (R1086), and a move that lifts a whole pile uncovers nothing.

player.title: Uncovered Units are summoning sick
changes: A Unit left on top when the card stacked on it leaves is summoning sick that turn, as if it had just been played. It still cannot attack again if it already attacked before it was covered.
